items.originalTitle: George Russell crashes out of lead at wet Singapore F1 sprint
detailZh: 乔治·拉塞尔在湿滑的新加坡大奖赛冲刺赛中冲出赛道，导致第2圈出动安全车。
拉塞尔在比赛开始时超越杆位车手马克斯·维斯塔潘取得领先。
由于突如其来的降雨导致比赛延迟。
拉塞尔在第2圈最后一个弯角处失控冲出赛道。
但拉塞尔并没有享受他的领先太久，他在第二圈的最后弯角失控撞车。
拉塞尔撞到了维修区墙壁的内侧，幸运的是，他在横穿马路时没有被来车撞上，最终在起终点直道的外侧停下。
这一事故引发了一辆安全车的出动，在中立区期间，维斯特潘领先，而汉密尔顿从第六位出发取得了出色的成绩，以及查尔斯·勒克莱尔。
在背景中，阿斯顿·马丁的兰斯·斯特罗尔和塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯在4号弯角相撞，导致两位车手都被淘汰出比赛。
红牛车队的伊萨克·哈德贾和阿尔皮纳车队的弗朗哥·科拉平托也退出了比赛，哈德贾似乎遇到了动力单元问题。
小红牛车手阿维德·林德布拉德发生打滑，排名下降至第17位，成为剩余参赛者中的最后一名。
detailEn: George Russell crashes out of lead at wet Singapore F1 sprint
Russell overtook Max Verstappen at the start of a wet Singapore Grand Prix sprint, but crashed out on lap 2
Mercedes driver George Russell has crashed out of a wet Singapore GP sprint, bringing out a safety car on lap 2.
Following a delay triggered by a sudden downpour, Russell took the lead on a wet start of the race by passing polesitter Max Verstappen on the inside into Turn 1.
But Russell didn't enjoy his lead for long, crashing in the final corner on lap two as he appeared to lose control over the white line.

Russell crashed into the pitwall on the inside and he was lucky not to get collected by oncoming traffic as he crossed the road sideways, before coming to a stop on the outside of the start-finish straight.
The incident triggered a safety car, with Verstappen leading during the neutralisation ahead of Lewis Hamilton, who got off to an excellent start from sixth, and Charles Leclerc.
In the background Aston Martin's Lance Stroll and Sergio Perez came together at turn 4, eliminating both drivers from the race.
Red Bull's Isack Hadjar and Alpine's Franco Colapinto are also out of the race with Hadjar appearing to struggle with a power unit issue.
Racing Bulls man Arvid Lindblad suffered a spin and dropped down to 17th and last of the remaining runners.

items.originalTitle: Mercedes boss admits team is baffled by failed 2026 F1 upgrades
detailZh: 梅赛德斯高层承认车队对2026年F1升级失败感到困惑
梅赛德斯工程师在乔治·拉塞尔将较老的车队规格车开到新加坡排位赛的前排后感到困惑
安德里亚·基米·安东内利，梅赛德斯，马克斯·维斯塔潘，小红牛，乔治·拉塞尔，梅赛德斯
对于梅赛德斯车迷来说。这里是关于银箭的最新消息，包括来自布拉克利和布里克斯沃斯的F1新闻、车手更新、赛车发展和比赛分析。
当梅赛德斯车队在新加坡大奖赛冲刺周末选择采用激进的车库划分策略时，目标很简单：收集足够的并排数据，最终了解为什么他们备受期待的空气动力学升级在马来西亚失败了。然而，这种激进的分规格测试反而让工厂陷入了深深的困惑。
在周五的滨海湾街道赛道冲刺排位赛中，乔治·拉塞尔驾驶着较旧的、之前的空气动力学套件成功获得了第一排的起跑位置，与杆位车手马克斯·维斯塔潘并肩。与此同时，他的队友安德烈亚·基米·安东内利——他继续使用新的、据称更快的升级——在车辆平衡方面遇到了严重困难，最终在第七位完成了排位赛。
对于梅赛德斯-AMG佩特拉拉斯F1车队赛道工程总监安德鲁·肖夫林来说，旧车显著优于大规模工厂更新是一个令人极其担忧的信号，这对其2026年冠军希望来说是一个警钟。
“在马来西亚的一个艰难周末之后，我们决定在本周末的新加坡使用分规格的赛车，”肖夫林向媒体解释说。“这不是最容易做到的，或者有冲刺赛制，因为这通常需要一些时间来调整赛车设置。”
尽管拉塞尔在前排展现出了令人印象深刻的速度，但梅赛德斯维修区远未庆祝。事实上，较老车型的更快速度基本上证实了车队的风洞相关性存在根本性的缺陷。
"我们今天看到了这一点，虽然我们很高兴看到乔治站在前排，但这让我们有些摸不着头脑，不明白为什么这次升级没有带来我们预期的性能提升。" 安德鲁·肖夫林坦白道。
虽然拉塞尔能够自信地从较老、经过验证的规格中提取最大速度，但安东内利在整个新加坡街道赛道的狭窄、苛刻的90度弯角中，一直在积极对抗新的空气动力学套件。
"两辆车都没有很好的平衡，虽然基米在刹车和进入阶段缺乏更多信心，而这正是你需要在这里攻击排位赛圈速的。" 肖夫林在谈到锦标赛领头的车手所面临的挑战时说道。
随着严格的 parc fermé 规则在周六的 Sprint 赛车之前严重限制了主要机械变更，梅赛德斯工程师将不得不依靠软件调整和轻微的前翼襟翼调整来尝试挽救更新的套件。
"我们将继续努力了解这是为什么，" Shovlin 表示。"我们周围有大量数据来尝试取得一些进展，希望我们明天能够把基米的车调整到更好的位置进行主排位赛。
detailEn: Mercedes boss admits team is baffled by failed 2026 F1 upgrades
Mercedes engineers are left "head scratching" after George Russell puts the older car specification on the front row in Singapore
Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes, Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing, George Russell, Mercedes
For Mercedes fans. All the latest from the Silver Arrows, with F1 news, driver updates, car development and race analysis from Brackley and Brixworth.

When the Mercedes opted to run an aggressively divided garage for the Singapore Grand Prix Sprint weekend, the goal was simple: gather enough side-by-side data to finally understand why their highly anticipated aerodynamic upgrade failed in Malaysia. Instead, the radical split-specification test has only plunged the factory deeper into utter confusion.

Following Friday’s Sprint qualifying shootout at the Marina Bay Street Circuit, George Russell successfully secured a front-row starting position alongside polesitter Max Verstappen while driving the older, previous-specification aerodynamic package. Meanwhile, his team-mate Andrea Kimi Antonelli - who continued to run the new, supposedly faster upgrades - heavily struggled with vehicle balance and qualified down in seventh place.

For Andrew Shovlin, the trackside engineering director for the Mercedes AMG Petronas F1 Team, the fact that the older car is significantly outperforming the massive factory update is an incredibly alarming sign for its 2026 championship hopes.

"After a difficult weekend in Malaysia, we decided to run our cars in split specification this weekend here in Singapore," Shovlin explained to the media. "It is not the easiest track to do that at, or have the Sprint format, as it often takes a bit of time to get the car set-up dialled in."

Despite Russell's impressive pace on the front row, the Mercedes pitwall is far from celebrating. The fact that the older car is faster essentially confirms that the team's wind tunnel correlation is fundamentally flawed.

"We’ve seen that today as while we're pleased to see George on the front row, it has left us with a bit of head scratching to do to understand why the update is not bringing the performance step we expect," Andrew Shovlin confessed.

While Russell was able to confidently extract maximum pace from the older, proven specification, Antonelli was actively fighting the new aerodynamic package throughout the tight, unforgiving 90-degree corners of the Singapore street circuit.

"Neither car had a great balance, although Kimi was lacking more confidence on the braking and entry phase, and that's what you need to attack a qualifying lap here," Shovlin noted regarding the championship leader's struggles.

With rigid parc fermé regulations heavily restricting major mechanical changes before Saturday's Sprint race, the Mercedes engineers will have to rely on software tweaks and minor front-wing flap adjustments to try and salvage the updated package.

"We'll keep working to understand why that's the case," Shovlin stated. "We've got plenty of data around us to try and make some progress, and hopefully we'll be able to get Kimi's car in a better place for main qualifying tomorrow."

items.originalTitle: Lewis Hamilton takes the blame for F1 qualifying blunder in Singapore
detailZh: 汉密尔顿承认新加坡大奖赛排位赛失误
汉密尔顿承认轮胎策略失误完全破坏了他获得新加坡大奖赛排位赛前排起跑位置的机会。
对于法拉利车迷来说，这是最新的法拉利F1新闻，包括车手更新、技术分析和来自马拉内洛及更远地方的赛事反应。
在新加坡大奖赛冲刺排位赛的开局阶段表现出巨大潜力的汉密尔顿，在决定性的最后阶段完全崩溃。尽管他的队友查尔斯·勒克莱尔设法在狭窄的滨海湾街道赛道上获得了稳固的第三位起跑位置，但这位七届世界冠军将被迫在周六的冲刺赛中从第六位起跑。
最终，这种巨大的最终排位赛速度下降完全是自找的。
当其他一级方程式车队的赛车在SQ3阶段使用多个冷却圈来为对温度非常敏感的倍耐力软胎做好最后冲刺的准备时，刘易斯·汉密尔顿选择冒险一搏。这位英国车手明确要求他的马兰罗 车库运行完全不同的轮胎准备程序，只在冲刺前完成一个冷却圈。
实验性的运行计划完全失败了。在训练结束后，这位经验丰富的车手立即举起双手，对灾难性的设置调用承担全部责任。
“在SQ3中，我们尝试了不同的运行计划，但事后看来，这不是正确的决定，”刘易斯·汉密尔顿在新加坡维修区对记者说。“在中等轮胎上，赛车感觉很好，但在软胎上，尤其是在我最后一圈时，我遇到了后轮抓地力的问题。”
在整个早期的SQ1和SQ2各节练习与排位中，法拉利车队Scuderia 法拉利 SF-26在黄色墙的中复合轮胎上看起来非常平衡。然而，一旦发车网格切换到强制性的红色墙软轮胎进行最后的对决，汉密尔顿的赛车后部完全失控，导致严重的过度转向。
"我们需要了解这是否是由于轮胎准备、平衡还是过热造成的," 汉密尔顿解释道，他正拼命地诊断这种突然的机械抓地力不足。
尽管错过了发车网格的前两排，这位41岁的车手仍然非常自信，认为赛车的基本速度仍然完好。
"今天的速度是有的，虽然今天没有发挥出来，但我们将会专注于我们学到的内容以及如何明天做得更好," 汉密尔顿总结道。
在新加坡狭窄曲折的街道上超车一直很困难，刘易斯·汉密尔顿如果想要挑战红牛车队车手马克斯·维斯塔潘——他获得了冲刺赛的杆位，以及梅赛德斯-AMG 奔驰一级方程式车队车手乔治·罗素——争夺领奖台的位置，他需要在发车时做出巨大的加速。
detailEn: Lewis Hamilton takes the blame for F1 qualifying blunder in Singapore
Lewis Hamilton admits that a risky tire strategy completely ruined his chances of securing a front-row start in Singapore
For Ferrari fans. The latest Scuderia Ferrari F1 news, driver updates, technical analysis and race reaction from Maranello and beyond.

After showing massive promise during the opening segments of the Singapore Grand Prix sprint shootout, Scuderia Ferrari driver Lewis Hamilton completely fell apart during the decisive final session. While his team-mate Charles Leclerc managed to secure a solid third-place starting position on the tight Marina Bay Street Circuit, the seven-time world champion will be forced to start Saturday's Sprint race down in sixth place.
Ultimately, the massive drop in ultimate qualifying pace was entirely self-inflicted.

While the rest of the Formula 1 grid utilized multiple cooldown laps to properly prepare their highly temperature-sensitive Pirelli soft tyres for a final flying lap in SQ3, Lewis Hamilton opted to take a gamble. The British driver explicitly requested that his side of the Maranello garage run a completely different tyre preparation sequence, completing only a single cooldown lap before pushing for pole position.
The experimental run plan completely backfired. Following the session, the veteran driver immediately held his hands up and took full accountability for the disastrous set-up call.

"In SQ3 we tried a different run plan, which in hindsight wasn’t the right call," Lewis Hamilton told reporters in the Singapore paddock. "The car felt good on the Mediums, but I struggled with rear grip on the Softs, especially on my final lap."

Throughout the earlier SQ1 and SQ2 sessions, the Scuderia Ferrari SF-26 looked incredibly balanced on the yellow-walled medium compound tyres. However, once the grid swapped over to the mandatory red-walled soft tyres for the final shootout, the rear of Hamilton's car completely gave up, resulting in massive oversteer.
"We need to understand whether that came down to tyre preparation, balance or overheating," Hamilton explained, desperately trying to diagnose the sudden lack of mechanical traction.
Despite missing out on the front two rows of the grid, the 41-year-old driver remains highly confident that the fundamental pace of the car is still intact.
"The pace was there earlier in the day, and although it didn’t come together today, we’ll focus on what we’ve learnt and how to extract more tomorrow," Hamilton concluded.

With overtaking notoriously difficult on the narrow, twisting streets of Singapore, Lewis Hamilton will need a massive launch off the line if he hopes to challenge Red Bull Racing driver Max Verstappen—who secured the Sprint pole—and Mercedes-AMG Petronas F1 Team driver George Russell for the podium places.

detailZh: 博塔斯解释他在阿塞拜疆F1的糟糕表现
减震器“性能衰减”问题和旧规格法拉利动力单元造成了较大的性能差距
博塔斯为他阿塞拜疆大奖赛不佳的表现提出了自己的看法，认为减震器性能衰减让他的凯迪拉克在比赛过程中的行驶特性越来越差。
这位芬兰车手在巴库的整个周末都举步维艰，基本牢牢占据成绩榜末位。而队友塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯在这座阿塞拜疆首都的赛道上延续了一贯的强势周末，这条赛道历来是这位墨西哥车手的福地。
博塔斯的比赛在最后一圈结束，他在15号弯撞上护栏，撞车时赛车的动力单元未能在超级压弯（superclipping）过程中为后轴提供正确的发动机制动力。
回顾阿塞拜疆大奖赛，博塔斯承认这是一个“相当糟糕”的周末，并解释了导致他表现平淡的几个关键问题。
“我明白从外面看起来相当糟糕；我在车里也感觉很糟。根本没办法跟上大部队，”博塔斯说道。
“比赛中我尝试了一切。得到了很多关于我在哪里损失时间的反馈。很大一部分是在直道上。但也有相当大一块是在整圈的各个弯角里都有损失。所以我就一直坚持推进到最后。这也是为什么我在最后一圈的1号弯出现了锁死。”
"最主要的是，我们在练习赛中就已经看到我的速度不足。我无法像佩雷斯那样在弯道中保持同样的速度。所以我们为排位赛做了很多改动，包括一些减震器和底板。实际上感觉好多了。"
"但在比赛中，行驶表现又退化得很厉害。我认为这和减震器有关，[它们]会随着温度升高而退化。"
"底板[也一样]，我们在这里那里还缺少一些压力测量点。所以我们[还]没有掌握空气动力学部件的完整信息，不像我过去习惯的那样，可以立刻看出自己是快了还是慢了。"
"但现在底板有些部分我们是盲区。不过对我来说，从感觉上讲，更多是行驶表现的问题，再加上动力转向在整个周末[不断退化]，导致我在比赛中也很难感受到赛车状态。所以，这些因素叠加在一起。"
博塔斯解释了为什么相比佩雷斯存在性能差距——他在直道上始终慢6到7公里每小时，原因在于队友换上了新的法拉利动力单元；佩雷斯用的是法拉利“ADUO 2”发动机，而博塔斯用的还是旧规格的动力单元。
在谈到凯迪拉克与其他车队整体差距时，博塔斯认为这支美国车队的基础设施相当扎实并且还在不断改进，但他解释说，为了赶工设计和制造他们的第一辆一级方程式赛车而进行的“仓促推进”，导致最终性能做出了妥协。
这与新车队负责人马尔钦·布德科夫斯基的说法相符，他指出车队为了赶上生产期限不得不走一些捷径。
“在调校方面，比如差速器映射、刹车映射等等，我们处于一个不错的状态，”博塔斯解释道。“我觉得我需要的东西都有。在发动机刹车映射这些方面，法拉利的支持也很到位。我们目前的主要限制仍然是在机械层面。”
"显然，设计这辆赛车的时间有点仓促。我们有一些不错的工具，但还没有达到我们希望的先进程度。而且明年的赛车在悬挂方面肯定会有改动，这将为调校方面的变化打开更多机会。但这正是我们欠缺的地方，也就是机械方面。"
谈到自己在巴库的比赛周末，佩雷斯认为"我在方向盘后面做出了巨大的差别"，在那场比赛中，这位前红牛车手一度看起来有望爆冷拿到一个积分。
比赛重启后，佩雷斯一度处于前十名的边缘，但最终掉了下去，因为他无法跟上身前的赛车。即使换了法拉利的新引擎，他也表示超车模式仍不足以抵消凯迪拉克MAC-26的阻力输出。
他表示，本周末在马来西亚雪邦赛道举行的巴林大奖赛上，车队将照常运作，不能再依靠他对巴库的特殊感情了。
"我认为目前的问题基本上是缺乏下压力，我们的赛车严重缺乏下压力，而且阻力也不大," 他说。"你知道，在巴库，我基本上整场比赛都保持在超车模式上，因此我能够跟上其他车手，但当我超越他们之后，我就完全是个乘客了，因为我没有直道速度。
"所以我们有两个大问题：没有下压力而且阻力很大——但我们一直都清楚，第一年会很艰难。
"很多事都可能发生，但我想，鉴于目前赛车的速度水平，我们差距太大了，而且这是一个很容易超车的地方。
"我对这个周末的前景并不太兴奋。我认为巴库只是个例外；在那里我做出了巨大的差异，而在这里，就赛车目前的状态而言，一切将回归我们的现实。
减震器的“衰减”会如何损害悬挂系统？
简单来说，当车轮压上路肩或颠簸而抬升时，或者当赛车承受任何形式的轴向运动时，减震器帮助控制通过扭力杆传递的能量。
在整场比赛过程中，减震器内部液体的压缩会产生热量。随着持续压缩，热量会改变液体的特性并降低其粘度，这意味着减震器产生的阻尼会变小。
因此，悬挂系统整体无法再吸收来自颠簸和路肩冲击的那么多能量，这意味着这些作用力会转而通过车架传递。
对于像巴库这样颠簸的赛道，燃油载荷开始对赛车的操控性能产生影响。底板表现也会出现小幅变化，因为这会对赛车的离地高度产生轻微影响。
detailEn: Valtteri Bottas reveals causes of his Azerbaijan F1 horror show
Damper "degradation" issue and the old-spec Ferrari power unit created a large performance deficit

Valtteri Bottas has offered theories behind his off-colour Azerbaijan Grand Prix performance, suggesting that damper degradation was giving his Cadillac increasingly poor ride characteristics through the race.

The Finn endured a struggle through the weekend at Baku, largely cemented to the bottom of the timesheets. This was magnified by team-mate Sergio Perez enjoying a characteristically strong weekend around the Azerbaijani capital, a circuit at which the Mexican has historically shone.
Bottas' race ended on the final lap with a crash into the barrier at Turn 15, in which the car's power unit failed to offer the correct level of engine braking on the rear axle while superclipping.
Reflecting on the Azerbaijan GP, Bottas admitted that it was a "pretty poor" weekend and explained some of the key problems that led to his muted showing.
"I understand it looked pretty bad from the outside; I felt pretty bad in the car as well. There was just no way to keep up with the pack," Bottas reckoned.

"Tried everything during the race. Got lots of feedback on where I am losing the time. A lot of it was on the straights. But also a big chunk was just all around the lap in the corners. That's why I just kept pushing until the end. And that's why I had the lock-up on the last lap in Turn 1.

"The main thing was we saw already in practice that I was lacking pace. I couldn't carry the same speed through the corners as Checo. So we changed a lot for the qualifying, including some dampers, the floor. And it actually felt a lot better.
"But then the ride again during the race degraded quite a lot. I think it's something to do with dampers, [degrading] with heat.

"The floor [too], we are still lacking a bit of pressure tappings here and there. So we don't [yet] have the full information on aero parts that I'm used to from the past where you could immediately see if you're down or up.

"But now there are some bits of the floor where we are blind. But for me, feeling-wise, it was more the ride, and that's in combination with power steering that was [degrading] throughout the weekend, and I was really then also struggling to feel the car throughout the race. So, those things combined."

Bottas explained the performance deficit to Perez, where he was consistently 6-7km/h slower on the straights, was down to the impact of his team-mate's new Ferrari powertrain; Perez had Ferrari's "ADUO 2" engine, while Bottas had the old-spec power unit.

Speaking about Cadillac's wider deficit to the other teams, Bottas reckoned that the American squad's infrastructure was pretty strong and continuing to improve, but explained that the "rush" to get its first F1 car designed and built had led to its ultimate performance being compromised.
This tallies with comments from new team principal Marcin Budkowski, who noted that the team had needed to make shortcuts to meet its production deadlines.

"When it comes to settings, like differential maps, brake maps and stuff, we're in a good place," Bottas explained. "I feel like I've got everything that I need. Also the support from Ferrari when it comes to the engine braking maps and stuff. The main limitation we have is still mechanically.

"Obviously it was a bit of a rush to design the car. We have some good tools, but not as advanced as we would hope. And there's going to be, for sure, a change to the suspension on next year's car. So that will open more opportunities for set-up changes. But that's where we're lacking, the mechanical side."

Speaking about his own Baku weekend, Perez reckoned that "I was making a massive difference" behind the wheel, in a race where the ex-Red Bull driver – briefly – looked like an outside bet for a surprise point.

Perez was on the cusp of the top 10 after the restart, but ended up falling back as he was unable to stay in touch with the cars ahead. Even with Ferrari's new engine, he stated that the overtake mode was not enough to counter the Cadillac MAC-26's drag output.
He suggested that it would be business as usual for the team at this weekend's Bahrain Grand Prix at Malaysia's Sepang circuit, without his affinity for Baku to fall back on.

"I think at the moment it's basically the lack of load, we have a massive lack of load in the car, and not a lot of drag," he said. "You know, in Baku, when I basically stayed on the overtake mode for the entire race and therefore I was able to stay with the others, but when I overtook them, I was just a passenger because I had no straightline speed.
"So we have two big issues: no load and a lot of drag – but we always knew this first year was going to be tricky.
"A lot can happen but, I guess given where the pace of the car is at the moment, we are just too far off and it's a place that you can overtake easily.

"I'm not too excited about the prospects for this weekend. I think Baku was a one-off; I was making a massive difference there, and here it will be just back to our reality in terms of where the car is at the moment."
How does damper 'degradation' hurt the suspension?
In short, the damper helps to control the energy moving through the torsion bars when the wheel jacks up over a kerb or a bump, or when the car sustains any kind of axial motion.

Through the course of a race, the compression of the fluid within the damper creates heat. With continued compression, the heat changes the properties of the fluid and the viscosity reduces, meaning that the damper produces less resistance.
As such, the suspension package overall can't absorb as much energy from bumps and kerb strikes, meaning that the forces are thus redirected through the chassis.
For a bumpy circuit like Baku, it can start to impact the handling of the car. There is also a small shift in floor performance, as this can produce a small impact on the ride height of the car.
keyPointsZh: 减震器性能衰减是博塔斯对赛车行驶特性变差的主要怀疑原因。
旧规格的法拉利动力单元也造成了较大的性能差距。
队友佩雷斯在巴库这条他历来擅长的赛道上表现强势，进一步放大了博塔斯的困境。
keyPointsEn: Damper degradation is Bottas's main suspicion for his car's worsening ride characteristics.
An old-spec Ferrari power unit also created a large performance deficit.
Team-mate Sergio Perez's strong showing at Baku, a circuit where he historically shines, magnified Bottas's struggles.

items.titleZh: 博塔斯解释巴库站大幅落后佩雷兹的原因
items.summaryZh: 博塔斯透露，在阿塞拜疆大奖赛上他平均每圈比凯迪拉克队友佩雷兹慢超过1.7秒，是2026赛季迄今正赛中最大的队内差距，他对此表示在直道和弯角都无法跟上节奏。
items.originalTitle: The slowest race of F1 2026 explained
items.summaryEn: Valtteri Bottas has revealed why he was on average more than 1.7 seconds per lap slower than his Cadillac team-mate Sergio Perez at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix, the largest race-day intra-team deficit of the 2026 season so far.
detailZh: 瓦尔特里·博塔斯透露了上一站巴库比赛中，他相比凯迪拉克F1队友塞尔吉奥·佩雷兹速度严重不足的一些原因。
在阿塞拜疆大奖赛上，博塔斯平均每圈比佩雷兹慢超过1.7秒之多，这是2026赛季迄今正赛中最大的队内差距。甚至他的最快单圈也比佩雷兹慢1.489秒。
博塔斯在最后一圈撞上护墙，因为他在驶过1号弯逃生通道后，赛车的能量输出模式“有点混乱”，而由于多跑了距离，他在进入15号弯左弯时后刹车失效，车头撞上了护墙。
但更令人担忧的是此前惊人的速度差距，在博塔斯撞车之前，佩雷兹几乎已经套了他一圈。
“我理解从外面看起来情况很糟糕，坐在车里感觉也很糟糕，”博塔斯周四在马来西亚说。
“当时根本没办法跟上大部队。我在比赛中尝试了所有办法，也得到了很多关于我在哪里损失时间的反馈。很大一部分是在直道上，但也有相当大的一部分是在整圈的弯道中损失掉的。
“所以我一直在坚持推进直到最后，这也是为什么我在最后一圈进一号弯时锁死了轮胎。
“不过是的，关键问题是在练习中我们就已经看到我的速度不够。我无法像佩雷兹那样以同样的速度过弯，所以我们在排位赛前做了很多改动，包括一些减震器和底板，结果感觉确实好多了。
“但在正赛中，行驶品质又明显衰减了很多……我们这次改动了很多东西，所以我觉得问题在于减震器随温度衰减，还有底板……我们在某些地方仍然缺少一些压力测量点，所以对于气动部件，我还拿不到过去习惯获得的完整信息。
“通过数据你马上就能看出性能是提升还是下降，但现在底板有一些区域我们完全看不见。不过就我个人的感觉而言，更多问题出在行驶品质上——再加上动力转向整个周末都在不断衰减。所以我在整场比赛中真的很难去感受赛车。
“这些因素叠加在一起。而且动力单元的差距可能比我们预想的要大，至少从数据上看是这样。
“理论上我们有一个数字，但那是新引擎对全新引擎，也就是新规格对旧规格的对比。所以，我想就是这些因素叠加的结果。我当时确实相当慢。”
动力单元方面的差异指的是佩雷兹在巴库已经用上了升级版 ADUO 2 法拉利引擎，而博塔斯还没有。
此前这被描述为“细微差别”，但正如博塔斯所说，这次升级的效果可能比最初想象的更大。
博塔斯表示，他的 ADUO 2 引擎能否及时送到、让他能在雪邦赛道使用，可能性是“五五开”；如果赶不上，他就得等到下周的新加坡大奖赛。
他的队友佩雷兹本周末不会使用这套引擎，而是换用自己引擎池中的另一套动力单元，以便把升级版留到更能发挥作用的比赛周末再使用。
佩雷斯解释说：“我们做出了一个我们认为胜算最大的决定。”
“这就是为什么我们会在这里承受一些损失。但我们希望这会有所回报。”
“我们对这个周末并不太乐观。所以我们决定把它省下来。”
正如佩雷斯所暗示的，凯迪拉克的车手们已经为艰难的周末做好了准备，因为雪邦赛道带来了两个凯迪拉克尤其难以应对的挑战：轮胎过热和高速弯角。
正如佩雷兹所解释的，凯迪拉克目前“赛车的下压力严重不足，而且阻力很大”。
“在巴库，我基本上整场比赛都保持在超车模式上，所以才能跟住其他车手，”佩雷兹说。
“但当我超过他们之后，我就只能像个乘客一样，因为我没有直道速度。所以我们有两大问题：下压力不足和很大的阻力。”
“但我们一直都知道，第一年会很艰难。”
detailEn: Valtteri Bottas has revealed some of the reasons behind his woeful lack of pace compared to Cadillac Formula 1 team-mate Sergio Perez last time out in Baku.

Bottas was on average over a whopping 1.7 seconds slower than Perez per lap at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix, the largest race day intra-team deficit of 2026 so far. Even his single fastest lap was 1.489s slower than Perez.

Bottas ended up in the wall on the final lap as his car’s deployment pattern “got a bit confused” because he went down the Turn 1 escape road, then because of the extra distance travelled his rear brakes didn’t work going into the Turn 15 left-hander, where he nosed into the barriers.
But what was more worrying was the alarming lack of pace before then, with Perez close to lapping Bottas before the latter's crash.
“I understand it looked pretty bad from the outside and felt pretty bad in the car as well,” Bottas said on Thursday in Malaysia.

“There was just no way to keep up with the pack. I tried everything during the race, and got lots of feedback on where I am losing the time. A lot of it was on the straights, but also a big chunk was just all around the lap in the corners.
“That's why I just kept pushing until the end and that's why I had to lock up on the last lap into Turn 1.

“But yeah, the main thing was we saw already in practice that I was lacking pace. I couldn't carry the same speed through the corners as Checo, so we changed a lot for the qualifying, including some dampers and the floor, and it actually felt a lot better.

“But then the ride again during the race degraded quite a lot... Again, we've changed a lot of things, so I think it's something to do with dampers degging with heat, the floor... We are still lacking a bit of pressure tappings here and there, so we still don't have the full information on aero parts that I'm used to from the past.

“You can immediately see if you're down or up, but now there are some bits of the floor where we are blind. But for me, feeling-wise, it was more the ride - that, in combination with the power steering that was degging throughout the weekend. So I was really then also struggling to feel the car throughout the race.
“So those things combined. And then the [power unit] difference was probably bigger than we thought, at least from the data.
“We've got a number in theory, but that's new engine versus new one, of the new and old spec. So yeah, I think those combined. I was pretty slow.”
The power unit difference is in reference to Perez having the upgraded ADUO 2 Ferrari engine in Baku while Bottas doesn’t yet have it.
This was previously described as a “small difference”, but as Bottas says the upgrade may be more powerful than first thought.
Bottas says it’s “50/50” if his ADUO 2 engine arrives in time for him to run it at Sepang; if not, he’ll have to wait until next week in Singapore.
Team-mate Perez won’t be running it this weekend, swapping to a different power unit in his pool in order to save it for a weekend when it will be more beneficial.
“We took a decision where we feel we got the best shot at it,” Perez explained.
“That's why we're taking a bit of a hit here. But we hope that it will pay us back.
“We are not too optimistic about this weekend. So we decided to save it.”
As Perez alluded, the Cadillac drivers are braced for a difficult weekend because Sepang poses two challenges the Cadillac struggles with in particular: tyre overheating and high-speed corners.
As Perez explains, the Cadillac has “a massive lack of load in the car and a lot of drag” right now.
“In Baku, I basically stayed on the overtake mode for the entire race and therefore I was able to stay with the others,” Perez said.
“But when I overtook them, I was just a passenger because I had no straightline speed. So we have two big issues: load and a lot of drag.
“But we always knew this first year was going to be tricky.”
